title: UCI Hits Eritrea with Hefty Fines for Racing Worlds in Non-Matching Kits
content:
Wearing matching kits is a non-negotiable in a world championship event, as Eritrean riders found out after receiving large fines post race.

Read the full article at UCI Hits Eritrea with Hefty Fines for Racing Worlds in Non-Matching Kits on Velo.
author: Will Tracy
